context7.description: Live documentation lookup — the researcher agent's core enhancement (resolve-library-id, query-docs).

chrome-devtools.description: Frontend debugging — inspect, screenshot, network, console for Vue apps. The one server ECC activates by default.

playwright.description: Browser automation and E2E — matches the planned Playwright E2E stack.

github.description: GitHub operations — PRs, issues, repos; completes the git-workflow loop after commit-reviewer.

jishi-design.description: Read and operate JiShi Design (即时设计) canvases — page nodes, selection details, image/SVG export, batch icons, jsDesign API scripts. Prerequisite: the 九匠即时MCP plugin is open in JiShi Design and shows connected (WebSocket port 19999). Pairs with the jishi-mcp skill for tool parameters and workflows.

postman.description: Postman workspaces, collections, specs, and environments (local server). Use the LOCAL server to test APIs on localhost — the remote server cannot reach your workstation. Add --code (client-code generation from API definitions, pairs with the api-design skill) or --full (100+ tools). API key: Postman Settings → API keys.

postman-remote.description: Postman remote MCP. OAuth — no API key needed: claude mcp add --transport http postman-remote https://mcp.postman.com/minimal. Swap /minimal for /code or /mcp (Full). EU region or API-key auth: add an Authorization: Bearer header.

_comments.usage: Copy the servers you need into ~/.claude.json (user) or a project-root .mcp.json (shared via git).
_comments.env_vars: Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders with actual values
_comments.context_warning: Keep under 10 MCPs enabled — every server's tool descriptions consume context window.
_comments.full_catalog: The full 33-server catalog (Jira, Confluence, Vercel, Cloudflare, memory stores, etc.) lives in the local ECC clone at everything-claude-code/mcp-configs/ — copy from there on demand.
